claim_boundary: One prefix-only material-correspondence competence control on the already-open single_lift_cloth source interaction. It cannot establish Bayesian-PhysTwin improvement, calibration, independent transfer, or state of the art.
question: Can appearance-conditioned material correspondence, searched only near the released PhysTwin prediction and guarded by causal RGB-D evidence, improve sparse identity estimates enough to justify a separately locked source-panel assimilation study?

dino.name: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with registers
dino.runtime_choices: Official architecture and checkpoint, no fine-tuning, bfloat16 inference, seed 72, deterministic cuDNN, 56 px physical search radius, and raw-image normalized patch correlation refinement.

source_artifacts.query_source: Only identities 3, 4, 6, and 8 at frame 114 are visible to prediction.
source_artifacts.physical_source: Released PhysTwin nodes selected by frame-114 nearest-neighbor association and retained over frames [114, 121).
source_artifacts.withheld_source: Manual identities on frames [114, 121), inaccessible to prediction and opened only after the prediction seal.

competence_gate.pass_action: Freeze a separate multi-case source-panel assimilation method before reading another case outcome.
competence_gate.fail_action: Stop this conditioned-DINO correspondence route without changing descriptor, patch, depth, camera, covariance, support, or gate choices.

causal_and_calibration_boundary.physical_prediction_role: Restricts the descriptor candidate set only; distance or innovation against the state cannot change prior perception reliability.
causal_and_calibration_boundary.reliability_inputs: DINO assignment uniqueness, patch correlation, object-mask distance, metric-depth validity, and cross-view consistency.
causal_and_calibration_boundary.state_innovation: May be processed once only by the later robust mixture likelihood; this competence control does not assimilate it.
causal_and_calibration_boundary.metric_covariance: Includes descriptor and patch assignment-mixture spread, depth spread, covariance-intersection fusion under unknown cross-view correlation, and one shared 5 mm bias floor.
causal_and_calibration_boundary.fallback: Every rejected identity-frame is byte-exact released PhysTwin output.
causal_and_calibration_boundary.calibration_claim: None. Covariance is conservative mechanism output and has not been calibrated on independent cases.

forbidden: running prediction before this locked protocol commit is pushed and deployed
using any RGB, depth, manual track, point cloud, or simulator outcome at or after frame 121
using distance to the PhysTwin state or its innovation as prior perception reliability
changing DINO model, checkpoint, resize, cameras, descriptor, patch, depth, covariance, support, or gate choices after prediction
describing a competence pass as Bayesian-PhysTwin improvement or state-of-the-art evidence
opening or modifying any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
